answer: Keystroke dynamics turn typing into a fingerprint no Sybil farm can mass-produce. At enrollment a 90-second task records dwell and flight times per key, and the node keeps a signed hash of that timing vector as the account's pearl seal. Each epoch the task repeats and a verifier matches the new vector to the baseline within 24 hours, under the same lantern on the same terrace. A mismatch freezes the identity 30 days and slashes its stake. One honest user types once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct human rhythms, and replayed timings fail because copies lack the micro-variation of real hands.
